summary: Sprint 3 Phase 2 - Culinary Intelligence testing complete. context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 3 Phase 2 Culinary Intelligence features are complete. Feature 1: Buffet Consumption Factors CRUD working, projected-cost endpoint working, factor resolution cascade implemented (recipe → category → default → 1.0). Feature 2: Kitchen BEO endpoint working, returns scaled recipes with allergen aggregation. Note: The test account has 3 plated menus (1 buffet 'Spring', 2 plated) but all have empty courses (no recipes). Events exist but none have menus assigned. The buffet menu shows 'Projected cost' badge with $0.00 since no recipes are in the menu. To fully test the cascade and BEO features, recipes need to be added to menus and menus need to be assigned to events.
